review_scope: All 23 paired installed views reviewed for visible shapes, materials and mapped surfaces. Frame lighting and reflections vary in several pairs. The runtime audit supplies the texture and mipmap contract. This is technical visual review of the surface packet.

images.observation: The tabletop, hanging lamp, floor boards and companion remain visible.
Glazed tile courses, grout and shower curtain retain their material separation under the beam.
The slatted blind, plaster, rug, furniture and resident clothing remain distinct.
Floor boards, timber rack, lamp and window finishes remain visible. There are small shading differences around the rug and bar of the window.
The mounted cabinets and sink remain visible. The candidate beam boundary and plaster shading are less uniform than the reference.
The gauge, painted casing, pipes and fittings remain distinguishable in low light.
The shelf, books, table and doorway stay visible. The candidate has cooler shading on the near wood.
The corner, tile courses and cistern housing retain separate finishes.
Masonry joints and relief remain discernible in the dark close view.
The open panel, fuse terminals and wall conduit remain legible. The cover looks cooler in the candidate frame.
Brass footrail, floor tile and the dark dog silhouette remain present.
The cat, wall portrait and ledge stay visible at the low-light station.
The overhead structure, ledge and portraits retain their material separation.
The brass plaques, individual mailbox doors and wall surfaces remain visible. The candidate is brighter across the centre bank.
Fins, valve, cloth and wall contacts remain present. The brass and nearby table show a different highlight level.
Rail posts, wood floor and masonry remain mapped and visible.
Tank, legs and city silhouettes retain their distinct materials and framing.
Cool terminal highlights and the paper on the dispatch board stay visible.
Hardware and grout stay distinguishable. The candidate changes the shading along the near cabinet.
The coloured floor residue remains visible under the radiator.
The raised surface, radiator and floor remain separable in the lamp pool.
The toaster, kettle, jars and crumbs remain visible. The candidate is brighter and less warm on the toaster and jars.
The dial and wall casing stay in the frame. The right edge is brighter in the candidate.
